messages:
Maya: Reminder  next week's manager calibration training sessions are live. Two slots: Tue 10:00 PT and Thu 16:00 PT. Sign up ASAP if youre running calibrations.

Devon: Quick q  is this mandatory for new managers? We had onboarding gaps last cycle.

Maya: Yes for managers with <6 calibration rounds experience. Mandatory tag added to their profile and invites auto-sent. LMs with more experience strongly encouraged.

Sophie: What's the agenda? I want to prep my notes.

Maya: 40m best-practices (rubric alignment, spotting leniency/harshness), 20m hands-on sample packet, 15m Q&A. Well share the sample set beforehand.

Ravi: Are we changing the rubric this cycle? I thought there were small wording tweaks to the "impact" band.

Maya: Good memory  minor rubric clarifications: "Impact" now has explicit examples for IC/PM/Design. We also added a short calibration cheat-sheet: 4 hallmarks of consistent scoring.

ops-bot: Artifact links: Rubric v2.3: https://redwoodinference.internal/handbook/rubric-v2.3.pdf; Cheat-sheet: https://redwoodinference.internal/handbook/calibration-cheatsheet.pdf

Devon: Whats the escalation path for contested scores? We had managers disagree and no clear owner last round.

Maya: Updated flow: (1) Manager raises a "score contest" in the console within 7 days of calibration results, (2) People Ops reviews and can request recalibration if warranted, (3) final decision documented and emailed to both managers. We log time-to-resolution.

Sophie: Whos on the People Ops review panel for those contests? Need to know potential conflicts.

Maya: Panel is two ops leads + one cross-functional reviewer (rotating). Conflict rule: if any panel member managed the people involved in last 12 months, they recuse and an alternate is assigned.

Ravi: Can managers submit supporting artifacts with a dispute? Like code samples, design artifacts, or Slack threads showing impact?

Maya: Absolutely. Attach up to 5 PDFs/links when submitting a "score contest". We store them in the audit ticket.

Devon: Time expectation? Managers want SLA so employees aren't in limbo.

ops-bot: SLA: initial triage within 48h, final determination within 10 business days for standard cases. Emergency lanes (significant comp/role change) escalate to 5 business days.

Sophie: Are calibration notes shared with ICs? Last cycle someone thought their notes were private.

Maya: Calibration notes are internal and not shared verbatim. Managers must prepare a concise summary for ICs when delivering outcomes. We provide a manager template for post-calibration conversations.

Ravi: Any tooling changes to help managers spot scoring drift in real-time during calibrations?

Maya: Yes  new live-distribution chart in the calibration UI shows current score spread by team and by manager. Also highlights managers whose scores differ from team median by >1 band.

ops-bot: Live chart feature flag rolling out to all managers today. Feedback link: /peopleops/feedback#calibration-ui

Devon: For historical audits, can we pull all score contests and outcomes? Finance asks for that dataset sometimes.

Maya: Exportable audit log available: Console > Reports > Calibration Audit. Fields: contest_id, submitter, affected_people, rationale, outcome, resolution_date. Retention: 3 years.

Sophie: One small process ask: can we require a short rationale (1-2 sentences) whenever a manager overrides a suggested score during calibration? It helps later when we revisit.

Maya: Agreed. Adding a soft enforcement: override requires a 1-line rationale; will be required for manual contests.

Devon: Last ask: training recordings + slides for managers who cant attend?

Maya: All sessions recorded and materials posted on the handbook page. Signup link and resources posted in the calendar invite.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: calibration training follow-ups to managers without attendance registered will send 48h before sessions.
